## What changes?
Explain the concrete before/after behavior and link the issue: Fixes #

## Change type
- [ ] Domain correction / false positive
- [ ] Source or category change
- [ ] Builder, format or website fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Migration / breaking change

## Evidence and source attribution
List affected profiles, example domains, source URLs, license notices and overlap/false-positive considerations. Do not paste credentials, client IDs or private browsing logs.

## Validation
Commands run, results, affected formats and relevant screenshots. If an upstream source changes, explain count increases/decreases and exclusions.

## Migration and rollback
Required user action, old/new URLs, compatibility period and how to revert. Write "Not applicable" for a non-breaking change.

## Contributor checks
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and preserved upstream licenses/notices.
- [ ] The change is focused; generated files come from the documented builder.
- [ ] Tests and format/site validation pass, or I explained the remaining failure.
